summary: This guide explains which equipment pieces and stats to choose in the Piece of Treasury event's Furnace. Players should skip helmets and weapons, focusing instead on either Chest armor or Gloves. For Enlightenment-focused damage dealers like Serpentemis, crafting a chest piece with Enlightenment main stat from the Strike the Unprepared set is recommended. For crit-scaling damage teams like Dauntless, Summons, Rally, or Aura, crafting Crit Damage gloves with ATK% and Crit Rate sub-stats provides high universal value. Players are also advised to hoard stamina bread until the Continental Challenge event opens, as it offers increased dungeon drop rates.
